title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 26 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 26)

content.overview: Section 26 permits the tribunal, unless the parties agree otherwise, to appoint one or more experts to report on specific issues. The expert may be required to attend an oral hearing for examination, and the tribunal may require parties to provide information, documents or goods necessary for the expert's work.

content.study:
Section 26 — Expert appointed by arbitral tribunal

Section 26 permits the tribunal, unless the parties agree otherwise, to appoint one or more experts to report on specific issues. The expert may be required to attend an oral hearing for examination, and the tribunal may require parties to provide information, documents or goods necessary for the expert's work.

Apply the provision by identifying operative conditions, exceptions, procedural stage and connected provisions. Do not substitute generic arbitration practice for the statutory rule.
